info.name: TenaxProp Mobile App — Full API
info.description:
Every REST call the Flutter app makes, generated from the repositories in `lib/`.

**Bases**
- `api_base_url` — REST mobile API (includes `/api/v1`)
- `web_base_url` — portal host; used by Trading + broadcasting auth

**Auth** — `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (collection-level). Run *Auth → Login* first; its test script saves the token.

**Envelope** — `{ success: bool, message: string, data: any, meta?: {current_page, has_next, total}, errors?: {field: [msg]} }`. Validation errors return HTTP 422 with `errors`.

**Regenerate** — `python3 docs/tool/build_postman.py`.

Creates the user. Response mirrors login (`access_token` + `user`, `email_verified: false`).

**App source:** `lib/features/authentication/services/auth_service.dart:49`

Signs in. Two success shapes:
- normal → `data.access_token` + `data.user`
- 2FA on → `data.two_factor_required: true` + `data.challenge_token` (no user yet). Then call **Two-factor login verify**.

Test script auto-saves `access_token` / `challenge_token`.

**App source:** `lib/features/authentication/services/auth_service.dart:23`

Completes a login that returned `two_factor_required`. Bearer = `challenge_token`. Response `data` may carry `access_token` + `user`; otherwise the challenge token becomes the session token.
